Exact statute article and exemptions: unverified (Riigi Teataja is a JS app and could not be read).
EE.digitalReceipt: Secondary source: receipts may be issued from any device in any suitable form, e-receipts are common and accepted. Consent conditions: unverified. A June 2025 vendor inquiry to the Finance Ministry about non-fiscal e-receipts shows no ministry answer in the record found.
EE.mandatoryFields: Accounting Act source-document minimum (via search snippet of riigiteataja.ee, not opened in full): time of transaction, description of economic content, figures (quantity, price, amount). Consumer-protection minimum receipt elements: unverified. Simplified invoice threshold: unverified.
EE.fiscalSystem: None. Estonia is a non-fiscal country: no certified/online cash register or fiscalisation system, no POS certification, no registration of devices with EMTA (secondary source fiscal-requirements.com/news/2308, dated 2023).
EE.realTimeReporting: None for B2C receipts (secondary source). B2B e-invoice: since 1 July 2025 recipients have a right to demand e-invoices (secondary).
EE.receiptIdentifiers: No QR/fiscal code regime found; sequence number requirement: unverified.

LV.receiptObligation: Cabinet Regulation No. 96 of 11 Feb 2014 (likumi.lv/ta/id/265487, amended to 2025): taxpayers receiving payment in cash, by payment card or other payment confirmation must register each transaction on a cash register / hybrid cash register / cash system / specialised device and give the buyer a receipt (para 3, 63). Exemptions (paras 82, 84-86, 66): services away from permanent place of business, own-produced goods sold at production site, certain services (lawyers, notaries, childcare, libraries, religious/political orgs), small cash-revenue businesses (average monthly cash income below six minimum monthly wages), patent payers, certain public bodies/transport/tickets, gaming machines, vending machines that cannot print and fully automated fuel stations. In those cases a registered receipt (registreta kvits) is issued on buyer request.
LV.digitalReceipt: Yes. Para 75.1: on buyer request and where technically possible, the electronic registered receipt is sent to the buyer's chosen electronic contact (or printed copy given). Electronic receipts stored in a protected database, kept 3 years, database location notified to VID via e-declaration (para 75.2-75.3). VID guide also notes new devices can issue digital cash receipts.
LV.mandatoryFields: Cabinet Regulation No. 95 of 11 Feb 2014 (likumi.lv/ta/id/265486) point 23: user name, tax registration code (or VAT number), legal address; document name 'cheks', sequence number, fiscal memory module unique ID, date and time; item/service name, VAT mark, quantity, price; VAT rates, totals excl. VAT per rate, VAT amount per rate; total, discounts, payment type, amount received, change; cash register chassis number; SHA-1 hash of the document and of the previous printed document. Simplified VAT invoice: allowed for domestic supply under EUR 150 excl. VAT (VAT Law s.126, per VID guide 'Kases ceks gramatvediba', updated 23.07.2025); a receipt lacking buyer details is treated as simplified invoice if transaction value is under EUR 30 excl. VAT; if lacking other required details a supplementary document (kvits) is issued on request.
LV.fiscalSystem: Certified cash registers with fiscal memory module (kases aparats / hibridais kases aparats / kases sistema), models checked against VID reference-model register (technical rules MK No. 95); users register installation, relocation, suspension, cessation with VID by electronic declaration within 3 working days (MK 96 paras 31-33); notify VID within 10 days of changing servicing contract; submit SHA-256 of device software within 3 working days (para 94.1). Receipt shows fiscal memory module ID, chassis number, SHA-1 hash chain.
LV.realTimeReporting: Not found in the parts read. MK 96 shows quarterly reporting only for numbered paper receipts/tickets. Whether devices transmit data online to VID: unverified (text truncated after char 100000).
LV.receiptIdentifiers: Receipt number must be sequential ascending, not repeated within at least one calendar year (MK 95 pt 21.14); fiscal memory module ID at least 48 bits; chassis number; SHA-1 chain; grand total counter. QR code: not mentioned in the text read.
LV.retentionYears: Cash register journal 5 years; control tape/electronic control data 3 years; technical passport 3 years after decommissioning; fiscal memory modules 3 years; electronic registered receipts 3 years (MK 96 paras 37.1-37.3, 24.2, 75.3). Accounting source documents generally: unverified.

LT.receiptObligation: Cash registers (i.EKA) record business income; registered in i.EKA. The legal act setting who must use a register and exemptions was not readable: vmi.lt returned HTTP 403, and the e-seimas text opened for obligation was an old (litas-era) version. Obligation scope and exemptions: unverified. VMI snippet (search result) says the obligation arises where customers pay cash/card, with exceptions e.g. home delivery.
LT.digitalReceipt: VMI Order VA-40 (2022) para 67.16: receipts may be delivered electronically if the device has that function; a buyer identifier may be included. A VMI draft order approving 'Elektroninio kvito naudojimo taisykles' (effective 1 July 2024, order number blank, status draft in the text opened) covers e-receipts: cash register e-receipts must meet register requirements; non-register e-receipts need date/time, sequential number, seller name/codes, items, quantities, prices, amount paid and change. Whether adopted: unverified. Consent conditions: unverified.
LT.mandatoryFields: VA-40 para 67: header (company name, register installation address, VAT payer or company code; individuals also name and business certificate number); Z-report receipt number, Z report number, overall document sequence number, date/time; item name (min 8 characters), price, total, quantity, tax rate/code, tax amount per rate; discounts/markups, total payable, amount received, change; unique cash register number; verification data (overall sequence number, security module ID, readable signature, receipt code, QR code if technically possible); buyer identifier if delivered electronically. Language: Lithuanian (para 15). Simplified invoice threshold: unverified.
LT.fiscalSystem: i.EKA: certified cash registers with security module or 'virtual fiscalization' device per VMI Order VA-40 (2022, e-seimas TAD c7560202c66211ecb69ea7b9ba9d787b). Unique cash register number assigned during i.EKA registration; from 26 Apr 2023 registration only by authorised servicing companies, owners use i.MAS (VMI snippet).
LT.realTimeReporting: Yes per VA-40 para 26: security-module devices send data to i.EKA within 72 hours; virtual-fiscalization devices send at the moment of signing; printing stops if confirmation from i.EKA not received (para 12); virtual fiscalization devices may issue receipts only after i.EKA registration (para 84).
LT.receiptIdentifiers: Unique cash register number (from i.EKA); overall document sequence number plus per-type number; security module ID; signature in readable form and encrypted receipt code; QR code built from those elements if technically possible (VA-40 para 67.15).
LT.retentionYears: Electronic control journal (EKJ) kept 6 years on at least two permanent media (VA-40 paras 80, 82). Accounting documents generally: unverified.

GR.receiptObligation: Every retail sale must be documented with a retail receipt issued by a fiscal electronic mechanism (FIM/ΦΗΜ: fiscal cash register, EAFDSS or ADIME) declared to AADE (form D13; no receipts from an undeclared machine). Card payment implies mandatory FIM receipt: the card terminal must be linked to the FIM (AADE FIM manual Odigies_fim.pdf, A.1098/2022 per search snippets, not opened in full because aade.gr returned 403). Table-service restaurants using simple FIMs were required to switch from 1.8.2024 (AADE A.1123/2024 snippet). Vending-machine exemption ran to 31.12.2025 (A.1201/2024); status for 2026 unverified.
GR.digitalReceipt: Secondary article citing decision 1035/2020: retail receipts may be printed and handed over or sent electronically to individual consumers if they can be shown to an auditor. Consent conditions: unverified. Not read from AADE text.
GR.mandatoryFields: unverified in full (A.1123/2024 content not readable). From search results: QR code on all receipts from FIMs transmitting to myDATA, mandatory for receipts issued from 1 Nov 2023 (powergame.gr article of 16.10.2023). A.1171/2021 (taxheaven, opened): FIM must transmit at least issuer VAT number, retail document type, serial number, issue date/time, VAT rate, total value. Simplified invoice threshold: unverified.
GR.fiscalSystem: FIM (Fiscal Electronic Mechanism/ΦΗΜ) regime: fiscal cash register with fiscal memory, EAFDSS and ADIME devices, declared via form D13, linked to AADE FIM information system (PS FIM) and, from A.1171/2021, to myDATA. Issued receipts cannot be deleted. If a FIM fails to transmit (over 10 Z reports), functionality restrictions apply automatically (AADE FIM snippets).
GR.realTimeReporting: FIM data is transmitted to myDATA/AADE (A.1171/2021: summary data at times set by technical specs, each transmission gets a unique registration number MARK; page does not say real-time). From 1.11.2024 retail income transmitted via the FIM system (esend) instead of ERP (AADE announcement 20.12.2024, via forin.gr/powergame). Legal basis art. 16(1) of Law 5104/2024.
GR.receiptIdentifiers: MARK (unique registration number) assigned to each transmission (A.1171/2021); QR code on receipt for AADE verification (receipt-check app 'Appodixi'). QR content: unverified. Sequence numbering rules: unverified.

MT.receiptObligation: VAT Act (Cap. 406, consolidated at 01/10/2026, legislation.mt, read from PDF), Thirteenth Schedule item 2: every person who makes a supply (except where a tax invoice must be issued) must issue a fiscal receipt immediately after payment; not required for supplies exempt without credit (Part Two Fifth Schedule, other than item 16(1)), OSS/IOSS supplies, or supplies taking place outside Malta. Item 3: retailers and businesses supplying catering food must issue it by fiscal cash register (manual forms supplied by the Commissioner only if unable for reasonable cause; not having a register or paper or a defect without prompt remedy is not reasonable cause). Taxi service: fiscal taxi meter. Special cases: daily receipts for door-to-door gas/milk/bread, canteens (authorised), vending machines. Commissioner may exempt persons/classes by notice (item 11). Customer must retain the receipt for 24 hours and produce it on request (item 12). Article 11 small enterprises must also issue receipts; MTCA guidance of 13 July 2026 (secondary: fiscal-requirements.com/vatupdate) requires labels 'E'/'Exempt' and identifier 'EXP' before VAT number.
MT.digitalReceipt: Fiscal receipt definition (item 1) covers a receipt issued 'in a manner as may be approved by the Commissioner' and electronic journal is allowed for registers; e-receipt for consumers: unverified. Invoices/fiscal receipts stored electronically must be kept in the original electronic form (Art. 10(2) of Eleventh Schedule, as read).
MT.mandatoryFields: Fiscal cash register receipt (Thirteenth Schedule item 13(2)): supplier name, address and VAT registration number; goods/services supplied; quantity of each item; whether each item is taxable or exempt; total incl. tax; serial number of transaction; the tax logo type specified by the Commissioner; cash register serial number; date and time; other details the Commissioner requires. Simplified invoice (Twelfth Schedule items 1(3), 5): allowed up to EUR 100 incl. tax (or where a document amends an invoice, or small-enterprise exemption); contents: date, sequential number, supplier name/address/VAT number, customer VAT number, description, total tax or data to calculate it (as drafted, includes customer VAT number).
MT.fiscalSystem: Fiscal cash register of a type approved by the Commissioner by notice (Government Gazette and web portal) with: itemised receipt, printed or electronic journal, inaccessible unalterable memory (Thirteenth Schedule item 13). Authority: Commissioner for Tax and Customs (MTCA). Secondary source only: POS systems need prior approval and a unique 'EXO' number printed on receipts; not verified in the VAT Act text.
MT.realTimeReporting: None found in the Act; secondary source says no real-time or online communication with the authority (decentralised).
MT.receiptIdentifiers: Serial number of transaction, cash register serial number, tax logo type (item 13(2)); no QR found.
MT.retentionYears: Records, including copies of fiscal receipts issued and fiscal receipts received, retained at least 6 years from end of the year to which they relate (VAT Act Art. 49-type provision and Eleventh Schedule item 10, as read).

SI.receiptObligation: gov.si page (opened, last updated 18 July 2025): invoices required under VAT rules and paid in cash must be confirmed by FURS before issue. 'Cash' includes banknotes/coins, payment/credit cards, cheques and similar; direct transfers to a transaction account are not cash. FURS Q&A (2015 PDF): obligation applies cumulatively to taxpayers that keep business books, must issue invoices, and receive cash; explicit exemptions exist (some listed activities, e.g. certain exhibitors, telecom services to non-identified persons). Buyer must take and keep the invoice on leaving the premises and show it to FURS or the Market Inspectorate on request (Q90). From 1 Jan 2026 no invoice needed for vending-machine sales, but machines must report transaction data to FURS in real time.
SI.digitalReceipt: Not addressed in pages opened; electronic invoice delivery and retention sit in articles unavailable in the free text. Unverified.
SI.mandatoryFields: Besides VAT/tax procedure content, an invoice issued with an electronic device must contain: time of issue (hours and minutes), identifier of the natural person issuing it (linked to their tax number), EOR and ZOI (FURS presentation 13.10.2015). Simplified invoice threshold: unverified (FURS VAT page does not state it).
SI.fiscalSystem: Davcne blagajne under ZDavPR (Zakon o davcnem potrjevanju racunov): electronic cash registers are connected online to FURS central system, which confirms and stores invoice data at time of issue (FURS Q&A Q7). Taxpayer must register each business premises with FURS before first invoice, using a special-purpose digital certificate ('DavPotRac', issued free via eDavki, per Pravilnik text on racunovodstvo.net) (Q&A, Pravilnik). Alternative: bound invoice book with data sent by 10th of following month; if offline, data resent within two working days.
SI.realTimeReporting: Yes: invoice data sent to FURS at issue and confirmed (EOR returned) before the invoice is issued; limited exceptions for later sending (gov.si; FURS Q&A).
SI.receiptIdentifiers: EOR (unique invoice identifier from FURS, UUID 8-4-4-4-12 hex, prefixed 'EOR'); ZOI (protective issuer mark, MD5 hash 32 lowercase hex, prefixed 'ZOI'). Per Pravilnik art. 5 (racunovodstvo.net unofficial consolidation): ZOI computed from tax number, issue date/time, invoice number, invoice value, signed with the DavPotRac certificate (the FURS technical documentation v3.1 may list more input fields; not reconciled). ZOI must appear as text and as QR code, PDF417 or Code 128 below the text (ISO/IEC 15415/15416); a third-party source says QR min 20x20 mm with 2 mm quiet zone.
